Setting Different Row and Column Gaps

options.text: 10px gap between rows and 20px gap between columns

quizData.explanation: In `gap`, first value is row-gap, second is column-gap.

slides.title: The Old `grid-gap` Shorthand ⚠️
slides.content:
# Legacy Names

Originally, gaps were `grid-row-gap`, `grid-column-gap`, and `grid-gap`. These are now aliases for the unprefixed versions. Use `gap`, `row-gap`, `column-gap` in modern code (they also work in Flexbox!).

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Gaps and Track Sizing

Gaps consume space. The `fr` unit distributes space **after** gaps are subtracted. So `1fr 1fr` with a 10px gap still yields equal‑width columns.
